about.label: About us
about.title: We Turn Vision Into Reality
about.paragraph1: Oguz Studio is a creative production studio based in Ashgabat. We design and build exhibition stands, indoor and outdoor advertising and visual concepts for brands that want to be noticed. Designers, 3D artists, engineers and installers work as one team, so every project is handled from the first idea to the final installation.
about.paragraph2: We believe a strong visual solution starts with understanding the client’s goals. That is why we work closely with every partner and offer ideas that are both bold and realistic to produce.

AboutPage.title: About Us
AboutPage.paragraph1: Oguz Studio is a creative and production company focused on transforming ideas into distinctive physical and visual experiences. We work across exhibition stands, outdoor and indoor advertising, 2D and 3D design, printing, promotional products and custom visual solutions. By bringing creative thinking and production capabilities together, we help brands create a stronger and more recognizable presence.
AboutPage.paragraph2: Every project begins with an idea, but bringing it to life requires more than design alone. We combine strategy, creative direction, technical precision and reliable production to deliver solutions that are both visually impactful and purposeful. From the first concept and visual development to production and final installation, we manage the process with attention to every detail. Our goal is to create work that communicates clearly, fits its environment and leaves a lasting impression.

CareersPage.heading: A Place To Grow And Create.
CareersPage.paragraph1: We believe the best work comes from people who care about what they create. At Oguz Studio, we bring together creative thinking, technical expertise, and a strong sense of responsibility to turn ideas into meaningful physical and visual experiences.
CareersPage.paragraph2: You’ll work alongside people who value initiative, precision, and a commitment to doing things well. We encourage our team to take ownership of their work, contribute ideas, solve problems, and continuously develop their skills. Every project is an opportunity to learn something new, take on greater responsibility, and see your contribution become part of the final result.
CareersPage.paragraph3: Whether you’re working on design, production, branding, or project execution, your work has a visible impact. We’re building a team of people who want to grow with the company, challenge themselves, and create work they can be proud of.
